newsitem.title: south korea: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 3.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Lee Han-dong, an advisor of the ruling New Korea Party announced on Monday that he will enter the race for his party's nomination for president
- The Seoul District Court on Monday sentenced Chung Tae-soo, the failed Hanbo Group patriarch, to a 15-year jail term on bribery, fraud and embezzlement charges.

- Park Chan-jong, leading presidential hopeful of the ruling New Korea Party, strongly hinted on Monday that he might not enter the party's presidential nomination race if Lee Hoi-chang continues as party chairman.
- Opposition Leader Kim Dae-jung on Monday hinted that he may accept a parliamentary investigation in connection with his 1992 presidential campaign funds.
